walkthroughs.body_html:
Fertiliser washes from fields into rivers.

Algae bloom and block sunlight. Plants die, decomposers multiply, using up oxygen. Fish suffocate. State the four stages in order.

Burning fossil fuels and deforestation raise CO₂. Methane from livestock and rice paddies also traps heat.

Effects: rising sea levels, shifting habitats, more extreme weather. Solutions include renewables and reforestation.

Approaches: protected areas, captive breeding, seed banks, controlling invasives.

: evaluate economic cost vs ecological benefit.

mcqs.q: What happens to an enzyme when it is denatured?
options: The enzyme has died because enzymes are alive.
Its tertiary structure (3D shape) changes, particularly the active site, so it can no longer bind substrate effectively.
The enzyme has been completely broken into amino acids.
Humans evolved from monkeys but chimps evolved from gorillas.

Humans evolved directly from chimpanzees, which is why chimps still exist as a less-evolved version.
Larger animals always eat the next ones up, and there aren't enough giant animals.
No — humans and chimpanzees share a common ancestor; both have evolved from it.

mcqs.q: Why are food chains usually limited to about 4 or 5 trophic levels?
options: Only ~10 percent of energy is transferred between trophic levels; eventually too little energy remains to support another level.
Larger animals always eat the next ones up, and there aren't enough giant animals.
There aren't enough types of animals to fill more trophic levels.
The enzyme has been completely broken into amino acids.
